text.sw: Chakula kinachopikwa kwa unga na maji, kinakuwa kigumu kama uji mzito. Ni chakula cha kila siku katika sehemu nyingi za Tanzania.
text.en: A stiff porridge made from flour and water. It is the everyday staple of much of Tanzania.

text.sw: Unga wa mahindi; pia unga wa mtama, ulezi au muhogo.
text.en: Maize flour; also sorghum, millet or cassava flour.

text.sw: Maji huchemshwa, kisha unga hukorogwa kwa mwiko hadi kuwa mzito na laini.
text.en: Water is boiled, then the flour is stirred in with a wooden spoon (mwiko) until thick and smooth.

text.sw: Hupakuliwa kwenye sahani na kuliwa kwa mkono wa kulia: unachukua kidogo, unakunja, unatengeneza shimo kwa kidole gumba na kuchukua mboga, nyama, maharage au samaki. Mikono huoshwa kabla na baada ya kula.
text.en: Served in a mound on a plate and eaten with the right hand: pinch a piece, roll it, press a dent with the thumb and scoop up the side dish: greens, meat, beans or fish. Hands are washed before and after.

text.sw: Ni chakula wanachomkaribisha mgeni nyumbani kwa wengi. Nyama na mboga zinaonyesha mwenyeji amejitahidi.
text.en: It is the food many families offer a guest. Meat and greens show the host made an effort.

text.sw: Ugali (Kenya), posho (Uganda), nshima (Zambia), nsima (Malawi), sadza (Zimbabwe), pap (Afrika Kusini); polenta (Italia) inafanana. Fufu ya Afrika Magharibi ni tofauti: hutengenezwa kwa muhogo au viazi vikuu.
text.en: Ugali (Kenya), posho (Uganda), nshima (Zambia), nsima (Malawi), sadza (Zimbabwe), pap (South Africa); polenta (Italy) is similar. West African fufu is different: it is made from cassava or yam.
